svg.title: Recall by entity type
svg.desc: Heatmap of overlap recall per entity type and system on the smoke fixtures.
svg.text: Overlap recall per entity type (share of gold spans found), per system
Fixture set 'smoke' (hand-written; en 10 docs + hu 28 docs), hu + en pooled. Cells are recall in %; n = gold spans of the type.
(kept) types are not masked by policy, so they cannot leak. Comparison tools have no recognisers for Hungarian identifiers.
